column1: # SQANTI-SIM threshold sweep (the release-blocking AUPRC sweep, see docs/validation.md "Calibration caveat").
# One row per rules.default.toml threshold configuration evaluated on the SQANTI-SIM
# truth set (GENCODE chr22: delete N transcripts -> PBSIM3 HiFi -> FLAIR -> SQANTI3 -> adjudicate).
# AUPRC ranks genuine-vs-false (threshold-independent); precision/specificity/nnc_recall are at that
# config's operating point. `operating_point=yes` marks the config shipped in config/rules.default.toml.
# Populate additional rows with benchmark/sqanti_sim/run.sh + score.py per config, then re-run
# `benchmark/results/collect.py` to refresh sqanti_sim/metrics.json from the chosen row.
